The CEO of the world’s second most valuable company in the world has stepped down amid a sex and spying scandal, and President Donald Trump, who shared a relationship with the ousted tech titan, is now telling the world who he thinks should replace him.

Writing on Truth Social , Trump said that “only one man” — former Apple CEO Tim Cook — could take the place of now-former Nvidia founder and CEO Jensen Huang, who resigned from his post on Thursday after the tech giant was rocked by reports he had an affair with a suspected Chinese spy .
Trump added that a decision by Nvidia’s board to name Cook, whom Trump once mistakenly referred to as “Tim Apple,” as Huang’s successor would mean “a Legend replaces a Legend.”

Cook, 66, served as Apple’s chief operating officer from 2005 until he was elevated to be the company’s CEO after the death of co-founder Steve Jobs. He stepped down as Apple’s CEO earlier this year but has remained the company’s executive chairman.
Huang’s resignation came on Thursday amid a scandal that has wiped hundreds of billions of dollars off the chipmaker’s market value, with share prices plunging 10 percent Thursday morning.

His troubles began last week when The New York Times reported that he’d carried on a long affair with another technology executive named Alice Huang, who American intelligence officials believe is either an agent or asset of China’s Ministry of State Security — Beijing’s equivalent of the Central Intelligence Agency.

Alice Huang, who is not related to Jensen Huang, is believed to have facilitated shipments of Nvidia’s microchips to Chinese firms in violation of U.S. export controls as part of a foreign intelligence operation. Beijing has denied the claims of espionage as“purely unsubstantiated and directed at smearing China.”
The Times subsequently reported that Mr Huang had also had a separate affair with Kimberly Powell , his company’s vice president of healthcare, who is also married.

After the first of the infidelities was disclosed, the executive sent a memo to Nvidia employees Sunday admitting he had been unfaithful to his wife of 40 years, Lori Huang, and said he was “deeply sorry” for the hurt he had case without going into details.
Nvidia’s board responded by launching an internal investigation led by law firm Wachtell, Lipton, Rosen & Katz.

The scandal involving the two Huangs has raised alarms among Democrats and some Republicans who have questioned what Trump knew about Jensen Huang’s behavior, whether it threatened American national security, and whether Trump and others in his administration turned a blind eye to the entire matter rather than risk destabilizing a company that has played a large part in propping up the American stock market in spite of Trump administration policies that have caused widespread economic chaos and increased the cost of living for millions of Americans.

Since Trump’s return to the White House last year, both Cook and Huang have cozied up to the 80-year-old president in conspicuous fashion, with both appearing at a state dinner honoring China’s Xi Jinping in September.

Huang has been particularly cozy with Trump as he and his administration have gone all-in on pushing to grow the American Artificial Intelligence sector to counter China’s burgeoning AI efforts, even as the Trump administration has relaxed export controls on top-end AI chips produced by Nvidia.

During a trip to China earlier this year, Trump had Air Force One make an extended stop at an Alaska air base so Huang, who’d flown there aboard his own private jet, could join the presidential party en route to Beijing.

The inclusion of Huang as a surprise passenger aboard Air Force One came after Trump had been briefed by top officials — including his Secretary of State and national security adviser Marco Rubio — on the Nvidia CEO’s involvement with the alleged MSS asset .
Earlier this week Trump said he had “absolutely no idea” that the first reported affair was with a suspected Chinese spy.
“I think ​he's an honorable guy," Trump told reporters, adding ​that Huang had “done an amazing job for our country”.
Republican leaders of three House committees have meanwhile called for Huang to deliver closed-door testimony on his interactions with the alleged intelligence asset.

And Democratic senators Elizabeth Warren and Chris Coons have written to Trump’s commerce secretary Howard Lutnick to demand that all company records relating to Nvidia’s dealings with China be preserved.
Joe Sommerlad contributed reporting from London

story.title: Trump floats Apple chairman Tim Cook as Jensen Huang’s successor

facts.text: Nov 12 (Reuters) - US President Donald Trump said on Thursday that former Apple Inc Chief Executive Tim Cook should replace ‌Jensen Huang as the CEO of Nvidia .

Last year, Cook presented Trump with a custom US-made plaque mounted ⁠on a 24-carat gold stand commemorating Apple's "American Manufacturing Program", after saying it would invest an additional $100 billion in domestic manufacturing.
Huang is one ‌of Trump's closest allies in Silicon ​Valley, and the ​relationship between the two dates to at least 2025.
Yahoo Finance is not a broker-dealer or investment adviser and does not offer securities or cryptocurrencies for sale or facilitate trading.

Over the past two years, Huang has repeatedly voiced support for the administration's ​agenda and become a ‌regular presence in Washington as Nvidia sought to sell advanced ​chips to the Chinese market.
Huang resigned as CEO and ​a member ​of the board on Thursday after ​reports said he had an ‌affair with a Chinese businesswoman whom US authorities suspect of spying for Beijing.
Nvidia has announced that Chief Financial Officer Colette Kress will take over as interim CEO.
Cook stepped down after a 15-year stint as Apple's CEO in September and is now executive chairman ‌at the iPhone-maker.
Apple and Cook ⁠did not immediately respond to requests for comment.
In a post on Truth Social, Trump wrote that “only one man” could take Huang’s place: Tim Cook of Apple.
President Donald Trump is floating the idea that former Apple CEO Tim Cook should take over the position.
Trump is not the only one to suggest Cook as a replacement for Huang.

Jeffrey Sonnenfeld , Senior Associate Dean for Leadership Studies at Yale School of Management, who studies CEO leadership and corporate governance, penned an op-ed in Time on Wednesday , suggesting Cook should be among the potential candidates.
He wrote that Cook has “an unparalleled track record of succeeding a bigger-than-life founder,” in reference to Cook taking over from Apple founder Steve Jobs.
Cook stepped down as Apple’s CEO on September 1, 2026, after 15 years running the company , but he’s still very much involved with Apple.
Whether or not Trump agrees with this opinion, or is simply blasting off an idea that hopped into his mind, is anyone’s guess.
“Tim Nvidia,” however, doesn’t quite have the same ring as “Tim Apple” does .
“NOW THAT Nvidia CEO JENSEN HUANG , who has done a fantastic job, has resigned, there is only one man to take his place – TIM COOK of Apple.
A Legend replaces a Legend!” Trump wrote on Truth Social.
29 and also traveled with Trump to China in May, resigned before the company’s board could oust him.
In return, Trump affectionately nicknamed him “Tim Apple” and was introducing him as CEO even after Cook had left the post.
The board was set to convene hours after the New York Times reported on Huang’s dalliance with Kimberly Powell, Nvidia’s vice president of health care, which further destabilized his leadership.
Cook, 66, led Apple from 2011 until August, when he moved upstairs to become executive chairman.
The Alabama native built a strong relationship with Trump by reaching out and soliciting the president’s input.
Nvidia and Apple are two of the world’s most valuable companies and have traded the top spot on most valuation lists over the past month as their stock prices have fluctuated.
Trump had backed Huang amid controversy over his relationship with Singapore-based Alice Huang (no relation).

Writing on Truth Social , Trump said that “only one man” — former Apple CEO Tim Cook — could take the place of now-former Nvidia founder and CEO Jensen Huang, who resigned from his post on Thursday after the tech giant was rocked by reports he had an affair with a suspected Chinese spy .
Trump added that a decision by Nvidia’s board to name Cook, whom Trump once mistakenly referred to as “Tim Apple,” as Huang’s successor would mean “a Legend replaces a Legend.”
Beijing has denied the claims of espionage as“purely unsubstantiated and directed at smearing China.”

The scandal involving the two Huangs has raised alarms among Democrats and some Republicans who have questioned what Trump knew about Jensen Huang’s behavior, whether it threatened American national security, and whether Trump and others in his administration turned a blind eye to the entire matter rather than risk destabilizing a company that has played a large part in propping up the American stock market in spite of Trump administration policies that have caused widespread economic chaos and increased the cost of living for millions of Americans.
Cook, 66, served as Apple’s chief operating officer from 2005 until he was elevated to be the company’s CEO after the death of co-founder Steve Jobs.

And Democratic senators Elizabeth Warren and Chris Coons have written to Trump’s commerce secretary Howard Lutnick to demand that all company records relating to Nvidia’s dealings with China be preserved.

The inclusion of Huang as a surprise passenger aboard Air Force One came after Trump had been briefed by top officials — including his Secretary of State and national security adviser Marco Rubio — on the Nvidia CEO’s involvement with the alleged MSS asset .
“I think ​he's an honorable guy," Trump told reporters, adding ​that Huang had “done an amazing job for our country”.

Since Trump’s return to the White House last year, both Cook and Huang have cozied up to the 80-year-old president in conspicuous fashion, with both appearing at a state dinner honoring China’s Xi Jinping in September.

The CEO of the world’s second most valuable company in the world has stepped down amid a sex and spying scandal, and President Donald Trump, who shared a relationship with the ousted tech titan, is now telling the world who he thinks should replace him.

The CEO of the world’s second most valuable company in the world has stepped down amid a sex and spying scandal, and President Donald Trump, who shared a relationship with the ousted tech titan, is now telling the world who he thinks should replace him.

Writing on Truth Social , Trump said that “only one man” — former Apple CEO Tim Cook — could take the place of now-former Nvidia founder and CEO Jensen Huang, who resigned from his post on Thursday after the tech giant was rocked by reports he had an affair with a suspected Chinese spy .
Trump added that a decision by Nvidia’s board to name Cook, whom Trump once mistakenly referred to as “Tim Apple,” as Huang’s successor would mean “a Legend replaces a Legend.”

Cook, 66, served as Apple’s chief operating officer from 2005 until he was elevated to be the company’s CEO after the death of co-founder Steve Jobs. He stepped down as Apple’s CEO earlier this year but has remained the company’s executive chairman.
Huang’s resignation came on Thursday amid a scandal that has wiped hundreds of billions of dollars off the chipmaker’s market value, with share prices plunging 10 percent Thursday morning.

His troubles began last week when The New York Times reported that he’d carried on a long affair with another technology executive named Alice Huang, who American intelligence officials believe is either an agent or asset of China’s Ministry of State Security — Beijing’s equivalent of the Central Intelligence Agency.

Alice Huang, who is not related to Jensen Huang, is believed to have facilitated shipments of Nvidia’s microchips to Chinese firms in violation of U.S. export controls as part of a foreign intelligence operation. Beijing has denied the claims of espionage as“purely unsubstantiated and directed at smearing China.”
The Times subsequently reported that Mr Huang had also had a separate affair with Kimberly Powell , his company’s vice president of healthcare, who is also married.

After the first of the infidelities was disclosed, the executive sent a memo to Nvidia employees Sunday admitting he had been unfaithful to his wife of 40 years, Lori Huang, and said he was “deeply sorry” for the hurt he had case without going into details.
Nvidia’s board responded by launching an internal investigation led by law firm Wachtell, Lipton, Rosen & Katz.

The scandal involving the two Huangs has raised alarms among Democrats and some Republicans who have questioned what Trump knew about Jensen Huang’s behavior, whether it threatened American national security, and whether Trump and others in his administration turned a blind eye to the entire matter rather than risk destabilizing a company that has played a large part in propping up the American stock market in spite of Trump administration policies that have caused widespread economic chaos and increased the cost of living for millions of Americans.

Since Trump’s return to the White House last year, both Cook and Huang have cozied up to the 80-year-old president in conspicuous fashion, with both appearing at a state dinner honoring China’s Xi Jinping in September.

Huang has been particularly cozy with Trump as he and his administration have gone all-in on pushing to grow the American Artificial Intelligence sector to counter China’s burgeoning AI efforts, even as the Trump administration has relaxed export controls on top-end AI chips produced by Nvidia.

During a trip to China earlier this year, Trump had Air Force One make an extended stop at an Alaska air base so Huang, who’d flown there aboard his own private jet, could join the presidential party en route to Beijing.

The inclusion of Huang as a surprise passenger aboard Air Force One came after Trump had been briefed by top officials — including his Secretary of State and national security adviser Marco Rubio — on the Nvidia CEO’s involvement with the alleged MSS asset .
Earlier this week Trump said he had “absolutely no idea” that the first reported affair was with a suspected Chinese spy.
“I think ​he's an honorable guy," Trump told reporters, adding ​that Huang had “done an amazing job for our country”.
Republican leaders of three House committees have meanwhile called for Huang to deliver closed-door testimony on his interactions with the alleged intelligence asset.

And Democratic senators Elizabeth Warren and Chris Coons have written to Trump’s commerce secretary Howard Lutnick to demand that all company records relating to Nvidia’s dealings with China be preserved.
Joe Sommerlad contributed reporting from London

The Dynamic Island now comes to Mac, serving as the home for Spotlight, 1 Live Activities, and Siri AI.
2 And with up to 24 hours of battery life in thinner and much lighter 3- and 4-pound designs, MacBook Pro is more portable than ever, empowering pros to take their work wherever inspiration strikes.
An enhanced six-speaker sound system now provides 50 percent deeper bass and remarkable sound clarity for even more immersive audio.
2 It is available to pre-order starting today, October 28, with availability beginning Friday, November 6.
“PROLED XDR is the world’s best laptop display.
It pairs state-of-the-art tandem OLED technology with advanced algorithms in our display engine to deliver the kind of visual fidelity pros have been dreaming of.
Crafted specifically for the Mac, every touch interaction feels incredibly responsive and refined.

Everyday tasks are simple and intuitive, allowing users to scroll through a webpage with a natural swipe; pinch to zoom in on a photo; drag and drop slides from one presentation to another; and double-tap a window to fill the screen, or flick to tile it into place.
And the touch sensor is built directly into the display panel — not layered on top of it — reducing latency so users feel like they’re touching the content itself.
PROLED XDR offers pros a super-wide color gamut with P3 and now Adobe RGB — critical for workflows in photography and design — along with notably wider coverage in green and cyan ranges.
2020 coverage for HDR video editing and color grading.
Cutting-edge factory calibration ensures luminance, white point, and color gamut are precisely aligned with standard targets.
Both color spaces are accessible within a single default preset, streamlining pro workflows and making it seamless to switch between them.
7 And macOS makes the most of the graphics, memory, and machine learning capabilities of Apple silicon, so apps perform at incredible speed.
The new MacBook Pro comes to life with macOS 27.

Siri AI can draw on personal context to help pros find what they need in the moment across messages, emails, photos, and more; answer questions about virtually any topic; and get things done across apps — all with groundbreaking privacy protections.

Siri AI is integrated into Spotlight and systemwide context menus, and users can ask Siri about what’s on their display with Visual Intelligence by using a dedicated keyboard shortcut to get help with a specific item.
Pros can also write and edit with Siri almost anywhere they type.
Touch also introduces entirely new ways of working for pro users.

Graphic designers can now use the entire display as their canvas, no longer constrained by the area of the trackpad when drawing; musicians can play software instruments right onscreen; and app developers can test how Touch performs in their iOS and iPadOS apps directly on the MacBook Pro display.
And these new ways to interact with MacBook Pro work in tandem with the keyboard shortcuts and trackpad gestures pros know and love.

In addition, a newly designed hinge provides greater stability while using Touch, and advanced video stabilization automatically smooths the camera feed in real time while using Touch on a video call.
Wi-Fi 7 and Bluetooth 6 provide fast, reliable wireless connectivity, and Touch ID enables a quick, easy, and secure login experience.
3 In addition, storage is now configurable up to 16TB.
Updated system gesture APIs also enable developers to create intuitive experiences designed specifically for Touch.

These include everyday productivity and collaboration apps like Notion, Canva, Zoom, Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook; powerful creative tools for photo and video editing like Adobe Lightroom and DaVinci Resolve; 3D modeling and animation apps like Blender, Maxon Cinema 4D, Maxon ZBrush, and Shapr3D; along with music apps like Algoriddim djay Pro.
Spatial Audio with Dolby Atmos wraps users in immersive sound for music and movies, and studio-quality mics deliver clean, clear audio for calls, recordings, and voice commands.

It is made with 55 percent recycled content overall, 9 including 100 percent recycled aluminum in the enclosure, 100 percent recycled cobalt in the battery, and, in a first for Apple, 100 percent recycled tantalum in multiple capacitors.
It is manufactured with 45 percent renewable electricity, such as wind and solar, across the supply chain.
As with all Apple products, its paper packaging is 100 percent fiber-based 10 and designed to be recycled.
Both deliver phenomenal single- and multithreaded CPU performance, along with faster unified memory, giving users blazing speed for the most demanding workflows.

M5 Pro offers game-changing performance for scientists, engineers, software developers, and creative pros tackling intensive projects, accelerating everything from compiling code and running AI tasks to sequencing DNA and editing multiple streams of 8K ProRes video.
M5 Max is built for users who want to push the limits even further, including 3D VFX artists, AI developers, and film composers.

With M5 Max, pros can run LLMs with hundreds of billions of parameters entirely on device and accelerate intense workflows across detailed visual effects, 3D animation projects, film scores, and 8K video post-production.
The 14-inch MacBook Pro now weighs half a pound less at 3 pounds, while the 16-inch MacBook Pro weighs just 4 pounds — 0.7 pounds lighter than before.
Today, Apple leads the world in innovation with iPhone, iPad, Mac, AirPods, Apple Watch, and Apple Vision Pro.

Apple’s six software platforms — iOS, iPadOS, macOS, watchOS, visionOS, and tvOS — provide seamless experiences across all Apple devices and empower people with breakthrough services including the App Store, Apple Music, Apple Pay, iCloud, and Apple TV.
Apple’s more than 150,000 employees are dedicated to making the best products on earth and to leaving the world better than we found it.

extraction.body: Apple unveils groundbreaking MacBook Pro with PROLED XDR Display and Touch for the first time on Mac The world’s best pro laptop now features an industry-leading tandem OLED display, an intuitive Touch experience, blazing-fast M5 Pro and M5 Max performance and AI capabilities, and up to 24 hours of battery life, all in a thinner, lighter design CUPERTINO, CALIFORNIA Apple today introduced the all-new MacBook Pro with PROLED XDR Display , featuring breakthrough tandem OLED technology that delivers game-changing front-of-screen performance. Available in 14- and 16-inch models, MacBook Pro with PROLED XDR Display offers a visual experience unlike any other, transforming pro workflows with up to 2000 nits peak HDR and SDR brightness, an industry-leading 10,000,000:1 contrast ratio for exceptional detail, a 120Hz variable refresh rate, and a wider color gamut covering both P3 and Adobe RGB for brilliant colors. The new MacBook Pro also introduces intuitive Touch capabilities on the Mac for the first time, opening up a whole new dimension for pros to interact with their content, from manipulating 3D models to playing musical instruments onscreen. The Dynamic Island now comes to Mac, serving as the home for Spotlight, 1 Live Activities, and Siri AI. 2 And with up to 24 hours of battery life in thinner and much lighter 3- and 4-pound designs, MacBook Pro is more portable than ever, empowering pros to take their work wherever inspiration strikes. 3 Featuring M5 Pro and M5 Max, Apple’s most powerful chips ever built for a pro laptop, along with up to 128GB of unified memory and now up to 16TB of blazing-fast storage, the new MacBook Pro delivers speed and capability for the most demanding workflows. An enhanced six-speaker sound system now provides 50 percent deeper bass and remarkable sound clarity for even more immersive audio. And Thunderbolt 5 and a wide array of connectivity, a 12MP Center Stage camera, studio-quality mics, and the power of macOS 27 with Apple Intelligence and Siri AI complete the MacBook Pro experience. 2 It is available to pre-order starting today, October 28, with availability beginning Friday, November 6. “The new MacBook Pro with PROLED XDR Display is a monumental step forward for the Mac,” said Johny Srouji, Apple’s chief hardware officer. “PROLED XDR is the world’s best laptop display. It pairs state-of-the-art tandem OLED technology with advanced algorithms in our display engine to deliver the kind of visual fidelity pros have been dreaming of. And with the magic of Touch coming to MacBook Pro, combined with the game-changing performance of M5 Pro and M5 Max, we’ve created a whole new way for pros to interact with their content, taking their workflows to a completely new level. The new MacBook Pro is the result of the deep integration between Apple silicon, hardware, and software, and there’s simply nothing else like it.” PROLED XDR: The World’s Best Display in a Pro Laptop The new MacBook Pro debuts the PROLED XDR display, which uses tandem OLED technology and advances it with breakthrough innovations in every layer, advanced algorithms in the display engine, and a state-of-the-art factory calibration process to deliver Extreme Dynamic Range (XDR) and stunning visual fidelity. With exceptional brightness, striking contrast, and vivid true-to-life colors, PROLED XDR offers the ultimate front-of-screen performance, enabling a new level of visual acuity and precision for content creators, photographers, colorists, and designers who need a reference-caliber display on the go. PROLED XDR is the world’s best laptop display, delivering true-to-life color and unparalleled brightness and contrast. The PROLED XDR display offers tandem OLED technology unlike any other, with deep innovations in its layers that keep brightness and grayscale uniform across the entire display, while minimizing internal reflections common in traditional OLED designs. It’s all backed by advanced algorithms in the display engine that precisely control each pixel in real time, plus a meticulous manufacturing process and precise calibration of every panel for consistency from display to display. PROLED XDR offers up to 2000 nits peak HDR and SDR brightness, allowing specular highlights to shine with stunning intensity. And through optimizations in the tandem OLED panel and custom compensation techniques, combined with precise control of light across the display, the PROLED XDR display achieves an industry-leading 10,000,000:1 contrast ratio, so even the deepest shadows reveal incredible detail, bringing HDR content remarkably close to reality. This results in more than 80 percent Rec. 2020 coverage for HDR video editing and color grading. With the new MacBook Pro with PROLED XDR Display, pros have a portable reference display on the go. With up to 2000 nits peak SDR brightness, combined with a state-of-the-art antireflective coating, the display is easy to read even in bright lighting conditions. For even greater visibility, the nano-texture option — now precisely etched into the cover glass — further reduces reflections and glare to eliminate distractions while maintaining an excellent viewing experience. With breakthrough tandem OLED technology, extreme brightness, and extraordinary contrast, along with a super-wide color gamut, PROLED XDR is truly the world’s best laptop display, giving pros an unparalleled visual experience and setting a whole new bar for the industry. sources.title: Apple should have made the MacBook logo RGB
passages: Nobody thought Apple would put a touchscreen on a MacBook either, and the iPhone Duo and HomeView also show Apple is in a new age of experimentation during the early Ternus era.
Maybe if the light-up lid logo ever comes to future MacBook Airs or a MacBook Neo, Apple could cut loose a little.

When Apple CEO John Ternus announced the first touchscreen Mac last month, the biggest reaction in the room wasn’t for the PROLED MacBook Pro’s OLED touchscreen or the thinner and lighter chassis; it was for the illuminated lid logo.
The most fun you can have with the Apple lid logo is to install a free third-party app like LogoLight and have it pulse, breathe, match the beat of any music you’re playing, or flash some Morse code.
But that means Apple could have used RGB LEDs.

extraction.body: When Apple CEO John Ternus announced the first touchscreen Mac last month, the biggest reaction in the room wasn’t for the PROLED MacBook Pro’s OLED touchscreen or the thinner and lighter chassis; it was for the illuminated lid logo. It’s a throwback to the light-up logos on the old MacBooks, which Apple started phasing out in 2015, and which were completely gone by the 2018 MacBook Air redesign. Just like in the old days, the new logo’s brightness is linked to the screen’s: The brighter or dimmer the screen, the brighter or dimmer the logo. But the light-up logo on the old MacBooks was illuminated by the screen’s backlight, and an OLED display doesn’t have one. Thanks to iFixit, we now know it’s lit by four white LEDs and synced with the screen’s brightness by software. But that means Apple could have used RGB LEDs. You can turn off the illumination with some Terminal commands or take control of it with a third-party app. But when it’s lit, it’s only lit with white light. And iFixit’s teardown also showed the difficulty of accessing those LEDs (the screen delaminated and broke in the process). The most fun you can have with the Apple lid logo is to install a free third-party app like LogoLight and have it pulse, breathe, match the beat of any music you’re playing, or flash some Morse code. Maybe if the light-up lid logo ever comes to future MacBook Airs or a MacBook Neo, Apple could cut loose a little.

sources.title: What's inside Apple's new glowing logo? iFixit tears down the MacBook Pro OLED - Notebookcheck
passages: Late last month, Apple unveiled its new MacBook Pro models, the first to feature both touchscreens and OLED displays.
Despite adding a touchscreen and bringing back the illuminated logo, Apple has also managed to make the laptop lighter.

The 14-inch model weighs 1.38 kg, around 170 grams less than the comparable M6 MacBook Pro. iFixit's measurements show that Apple reduced the weight of both the aluminum bottom cover and the display assembly while keeping the battery capacity almost unchanged.
The teardown revealed other details about Apple's new laptop.
Its tandem OLED panel has a 120 Hz refresh rate and can reach 2,000 nits of peak brightness.
Under a microscope, iFixit noticed that the blue subpixels are considerably larger than the red and green ones.
Blue OLED materials tend to wear out faster, so giving them a larger area could help reduce the strain on the individual pixels.
The Apple logo itself has a mirror-like coating, so it looks shiny even when the LEDs are switched off.
There is some good news for repairability, too. iFixit found that replacing the display lid is no more difficult than on the previous generation.
The repair process also no longer requires a separate lid-angle sensor, and Apple's repair software successfully recognized a replacement logic board, display and Touch ID sensor.
On older MacBooks, the logo glowed thanks to light from the display's backlight shining through an apple-shaped cutout in the lid.

sources.title: Apple's Next-Gen MacBook Pro Is Here With An OLED Touchscreen And A Fan-Favorite Feature Returning - BGR
passages: The rest of the MacBook Pro also gets somewhat of a redesign.
By far the biggest update is the return of the glowing Apple logo on the lid — a fan-favorite feature that was axed back in 2015.
Alongside it, the chassis is slightly thinner, the bezels around the display are thinner, and the new machines are noticeably lighter than the models they replace.
The 14-inch model drops half a pound to land at 3 pounds, while the 16-inch is 4 pounds.
That being said, the overall shape carries over — it still looks like a MacBook Pro.
Instead, buyers can now pick between two designs.
The M6 14-inch MacBook Pro offers the newest chip, the existing chassis, and a mini-LED display at $1,999.
Then, these touchscreen models offer the OLED panel, the lighter body, and the Pro and Max chips at a considerable premium.
After years of rumors, Apple finally announced its first touchscreen MacBook Pro models on October 28.
In addition to being a touchscreen, the new display also uses an OLED panel (dubbed PROLED XDR) for the first time in a MacBook, building on the iPad Pro 's tandem OLED tech.
Switching to OLED means the machines can deliver the same per-pixel lighting that gives the iPhone and iPad Pro their deeper blacks and higher contrast.
Apple quotes up to 2,000 nits of peak brightness for both HDR and SDR content, a 10,000,000:1 contrast ratio, and a refresh rate that varies from 10Hz to 120Hz.
The panel covers P3 and Adobe RGB, and the nano-texture option is etched directly into the cover glass.
The hinge seems to have received most of Apple's attention, for obvious reasons.
Pressing and poking a laptop screen pushes it backward.
On most touchscreen laptops, the display rocks every time you tap it.
To avoid this, Apple designed its MacBook hinge to hold the display steady even when a finger is prodding at it.
Apple has also added video stabilization that smooths the camera feed if you touch the screen during video calls.
Existing apps will work without any changes, since macOS simply translates a touch into a click.
The Dynamic Island also becomes the home for Spotlight, Live Activities, and Siri AI, so searching your Mac or asking Siri a question happens at the top of the screen.
The touch sensor sits inside the display panel rather than on top of it, which Apple says reduces latency.
Apple's new CEO, John Ternus, reportedly spearheaded the development of the new machine.
His position was that Apple had fallen behind on this, and that a touchscreen had become something buyers expect on a laptop rather than a differentiator.
Touchscreen Windows laptops have been around for more than a decade, though touch barely registers in the laptop rankings Consumer Reports puts together .
The ports are the same, with three Thunderbolt 5 connections, HDMI, an SDXC card slot, MagSafe, and a headphone jack.
It can support three external displays on M5 Pro and four on M5 Max.
Battery life runs up to 24 hours, and the six-speaker system gets a new woofer design that Apple says delivers 50% deeper bass.
Apple reworked the thermal system as well to move air through the hinge, which should improve airflow and cut weight at the same time.

coreStoryFacts.text: Apple unveils groundbreaking MacBook Pro with PROLED XDR Display and Touch for the first time on Mac
The Dynamic Island now comes to Mac, serving as the home for Spotlight, 1 Live Activities, and Siri AI.
2 And with up to 24 hours of battery life in thinner and much lighter 3- and 4-pound designs, MacBook Pro is more portable than ever, empowering pros to take their work wherever inspiration strikes.
An enhanced six-speaker sound system now provides 50 percent deeper bass and remarkable sound clarity for even more immersive audio.
2 It is available to pre-order starting today, October 28, with availability beginning Friday, November 6.
“PROLED XDR is the world’s best laptop display.
It pairs state-of-the-art tandem OLED technology with advanced algorithms in our display engine to deliver the kind of visual fidelity pros have been dreaming of.
Crafted specifically for the Mac, every touch interaction feels incredibly responsive and refined.

Everyday tasks are simple and intuitive, allowing users to scroll through a webpage with a natural swipe; pinch to zoom in on a photo; drag and drop slides from one presentation to another; and double-tap a window to fill the screen, or flick to tile it into place.
And the touch sensor is built directly into the display panel — not layered on top of it — reducing latency so users feel like they’re touching the content itself.
PROLED XDR offers pros a super-wide color gamut with P3 and now Adobe RGB — critical for workflows in photography and design — along with notably wider coverage in green and cyan ranges.
2020 coverage for HDR video editing and color grading.
Cutting-edge factory calibration ensures luminance, white point, and color gamut are precisely aligned with standard targets.

The most fun you can have with the Apple lid logo is to install a free third-party app like LogoLight and have it pulse, breathe, match the beat of any music you’re playing, or flash some Morse code.
But that means Apple could have used RGB LEDs.
Late last month, Apple unveiled its new MacBook Pro models, the first to feature both touchscreens and OLED displays.
Despite adding a touchscreen and bringing back the illuminated logo, Apple has also managed to make the laptop lighter.

The 14-inch model weighs 1.38 kg, around 170 grams less than the comparable M6 MacBook Pro. iFixit's measurements show that Apple reduced the weight of both the aluminum bottom cover and the display assembly while keeping the battery capacity almost unchanged.
The teardown revealed other details about Apple's new laptop.
Its tandem OLED panel has a 120 Hz refresh rate and can reach 2,000 nits of peak brightness.
Under a microscope, iFixit noticed that the blue subpixels are considerably larger than the red and green ones.
Blue OLED materials tend to wear out faster, so giving them a larger area could help reduce the strain on the individual pixels.
The Apple logo itself has a mirror-like coating, so it looks shiny even when the LEDs are switched off.
There is some good news for repairability, too. iFixit found that replacing the display lid is no more difficult than on the previous generation.

On older MacBooks, the logo glowed thanks to light from the display's backlight shining through an apple-shaped cutout in the lid.

Switching to OLED means the machines can deliver the same per-pixel lighting that gives the iPhone and iPad Pro their deeper blacks and higher contrast.
Apple quotes up to 2,000 nits of peak brightness for both HDR and SDR content, a 10,000,000:1 contrast ratio, and a refresh rate that varies from 10Hz to 120Hz.
The panel covers P3 and Adobe RGB, and the nano-texture option is etched directly into the cover glass.

Pressing and poking a laptop screen pushes it backward.
On most touchscreen laptops, the display rocks every time you tap it.
To avoid this, Apple designed its MacBook hinge to hold the display steady even when a finger is prodding at it.
Apple has also added video stabilization that smooths the camera feed if you touch the screen during video calls.
Existing apps will work without any changes, since macOS simply translates a touch into a click.

The touch sensor sits inside the display panel rather than on top of it, which Apple says reduces latency.
Apple's new CEO, John Ternus, reportedly spearheaded the development of the new machine.
His position was that Apple had fallen behind on this, and that a touchscreen had become something buyers expect on a laptop rather than a differentiator.
Touchscreen Windows laptops have been around for more than a decade, though touch barely registers in the laptop rankings Consumer Reports puts together .
The ports are the same, with three Thunderbolt 5 connections, HDMI, an SDXC card slot, MagSafe, and a headphone jack.
It can support three external displays on M5 Pro and four on M5 Max.

Available in 14- and 16-inch models, MacBook Pro with PROLED XDR Display offers a visual experience unlike any other, transforming pro workflows with up to 2000 nits peak HDR and SDR brightness, an industry-leading 10,000,000:1 contrast ratio for exceptional detail, a 120Hz variable refresh rate, and a wider color gamut covering both P3 and Adobe RGB for brilliant colors. The new MacBook Pro also introduces intuitive Touch capabilities on the Mac for the first time, opening up a whole new dimension for pros to interact with their content, from manipulating 3D models to playing musical instruments onscreen. The Dynamic Island now comes to Mac, serving as the home for Spotlight, 1 Live Activities, and Siri AI. 2 And with up to 24 hours of battery life in thinner and much lighter 3- and 4-pound designs, MacBook Pro is more portable than ever, empowering pros to take their work wherever inspiration strikes. 3 Featuring M5 Pro and M5 Max, Apple’s most powerful chips ever built for a pro laptop, along with up to 128GB of unified memory and now up to 16TB of blazing-fast storage, the new MacBook Pro delivers speed and capability for the most demanding workflows. An enhanced six-speaker sound system now provides 50 percent deeper bass and remarkable sound clarity for even more immersive audio. And Thunderbolt 5 and a wide array of connectivity, a 12MP Center Stage camera, studio-quality mics, and the power of macOS 27 with Apple Intelligence and Siri AI complete the MacBook Pro experience. 2 It is available to pre-order starting today, October 28, with availability beginning Friday, November 6.

“The new MacBook Pro with PROLED XDR Display is a monumental step forward for the Mac,” said Johny Srouji, Apple’s chief hardware officer. “PROLED XDR is the world’s best laptop display. It pairs state-of-the-art tandem OLED technology with advanced algorithms in our display engine to deliver the kind of visual fidelity pros have been dreaming of. And with the magic of Touch coming to MacBook Pro, combined with the game-changing performance of M5 Pro and M5 Max, we’ve created a whole new way for pros to interact with their content, taking their workflows to a completely new level. The new MacBook Pro is the result of the deep integration between Apple silicon, hardware, and software, and there’s simply nothing else like it.”
PROLED XDR: The World’s Best Display in a Pro Laptop

The new MacBook Pro debuts the PROLED XDR display, which uses tandem OLED technology and advances it with breakthrough innovations in every layer, advanced algorithms in the display engine, and a state-of-the-art factory calibration process to deliver Extreme Dynamic Range (XDR) and stunning visual fidelity. With exceptional brightness, striking contrast, and vivid true-to-life colors, PROLED XDR offers the ultimate front-of-screen performance, enabling a new level of visual acuity and precision for content creators, photographers, colorists, and designers who need a reference-caliber display on the go.

PROLED XDR is the world’s best laptop display, delivering true-to-life color and unparalleled brightness and contrast. The PROLED XDR display offers tandem OLED technology unlike any other, with deep innovations in its layers that keep brightness and grayscale uniform across the entire display, while minimizing internal reflections common in traditional OLED designs. It’s all backed by advanced algorithms in the display engine that precisely control each pixel in real time, plus a meticulous manufacturing process and precise calibration of every panel for consistency from display to display.

PROLED XDR offers up to 2000 nits peak HDR and SDR brightness, allowing specular highlights to shine with stunning intensity. And through optimizations in the tandem OLED panel and custom compensation techniques, combined with precise control of light across the display, the PROLED XDR display achieves an industry-leading 10,000,000:1 contrast ratio, so even the deepest shadows reveal incredible detail, bringing HDR content remarkably close to reality.
The Ultimate Display for Color-Critical Workflows

PROLED XDR offers pros a super-wide color gamut with P3 and now Adobe RGB — critical for workflows in photography and design — along with notably wider coverage in green and cyan ranges. This results in more than 80 percent Rec. 2020 coverage for HDR video editing and color grading. Cutting-edge factory calibration ensures luminance, white point, and color gamut are precisely aligned with standard targets. Both color spaces are accessible within a single default preset, streamlining pro workflows and making it seamless to switch between them. With the new MacBook Pro with PROLED XDR Display, pros have a portable reference display on the go.

With up to 2000 nits peak SDR brightness, combined with a state-of-the-art antireflective coating, the display is easy to read even in bright lighting conditions. For even greater visibility, the nano-texture option — now precisely etched into the cover glass — further reduces reflections and glare to eliminate distractions while maintaining an excellent viewing experience.

With breakthrough tandem OLED technology, extreme brightness, and extraordinary contrast, along with a super-wide color gamut, PROLED XDR is truly the world’s best laptop display, giving pros an unparalleled visual experience and setting a whole new bar for the industry.

MacBook Pro features Touch for the first time, bringing pros a whole new way to interact with their content. Crafted specifically for the Mac, every touch interaction feels incredibly responsive and refined. Everyday tasks are simple and intuitive, allowing users to scroll through a webpage with a natural swipe; pinch to zoom in on a photo; drag and drop slides from one presentation to another; and double-tap a window to fill the screen, or flick to tile it into place. And the touch sensor is built directly into the display panel — not layered on top of it — reducing latency so users feel like they’re touching the content itself.

Touch also introduces entirely new ways of working for pro users. Graphic designers can now use the entire display as their canvas, no longer constrained by the area of the trackpad when drawing; musicians can play software instruments right onscreen; and app developers can test how Touch performs in their iOS and iPadOS apps directly on the MacBook Pro display. And these new ways to interact with MacBook Pro work in tandem with the keyboard shortcuts and trackpad gestures pros know and love. In addition, a newly designed hinge provides greater stability while using Touch, and advanced video stabilization automatically smooths the camera feed in real time while using Touch on a video call.

Apple apps are optimized for the new MacBook Pro, and many existing apps work with Touch right away, because macOS automatically translates touches into clicks. Updated system gesture APIs also enable developers to create intuitive experiences designed specifically for Touch. And a wide range of third-party apps that pros rely on every day will also take advantage of Touch on the new MacBook Pro, bringing new ways to interact with their favorite tools and workflows. These include everyday productivity and collaboration apps like Notion, Canva, Zoom, Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook; powerful creative tools for photo and video editing like Adobe Lightroom and DaVinci Resolve; 3D modeling and animation apps like Blender, Maxon Cinema 4D, Maxon ZBrush, and Shapr3D; along with music apps like Algoriddim djay Pro. 4

The Dynamic Island comes to the Mac, serving as the new home for Spotlight, Live Activities, and Siri AI, where users can quickly search for anything on their MacBook Pro, access real-time updates, or take advantage of Siri AI. 1 Just like on iPhone, the Dynamic Island provides a quick, intuitive way to see and interact with important information. Users can ask a question, pick up a phone call, or control music — all within easy reach. With Live Activities, users can now get timely updates at a glance, and can accept an AirDrop request or pause a song with a tap of their finger.

The new MacBook Pro is thinner and significantly lighter for even better portability. The 14-inch MacBook Pro now weighs half a pound less at 3 pounds, while the 16-inch MacBook Pro weighs just 4 pounds — 0.7 pounds lighter than before. 5 Both models feature a slimmer design enabled by OLED’s more efficient display stack, with the 16-inch model nearly a millimeter thinner and the 14-inch model half a millimeter thinner.

With slimmer display borders, the 16-inch display grows to 16.3 inches, while the 14-inch display delivers a more portable 14.2-inch design. 6 And a completely redesigned thermal architecture enables the same incredible sustained performance of M5 Pro and M5 Max, even in a lighter design, while redirecting warm air away from the display.
M5 Pro and M5 Max: Game‑Changing Pro Performance and On-Device AI

The new MacBook Pro features M5 Pro and M5 Max, Apple’s most powerful chips ever built for a pro laptop. Both deliver phenomenal single- and multithreaded CPU performance, along with faster unified memory, giving users blazing speed for the most demanding workflows. M5 Pro offers game-changing performance for scientists, engineers, software developers, and creative pros tackling intensive projects, accelerating everything from compiling code and running AI tasks to sequencing DNA and editing multiple streams of 8K ProRes video. M5 Max is built for users who want to push the limits even further, including 3D VFX artists, AI developers, and film composers. With M5 Max, pros can run LLMs with hundreds of billions of parameters entirely on device and accelerate intense workflows across detailed visual effects, 3D animation projects, film scores, and 8K video post-production.

A powerful Neural Accelerator built into each GPU core lets users speed through AI workloads like running a coding agent with an on-device LLM. And users are able to power through advanced graphics-intensive tasks like rendering a complex scene in Cinema 4D with Redshift. M5 Pro and M5 Max each feature a GPU with enhanced shader cores and a third-generation ray-tracing engine, delivering more photorealistic lighting and faster renders for 3D modeling. Dynamic Caching optimizes on-chip memory to significantly increase GPU utilization, driving huge performance boosts for apps like Blender and Unreal Engine, along with AAA games.

The industry-leading six-speaker audio system in the new MacBook Pro features an all-new woofer design that provides 50 percent deeper bass and all-new tweeters that shape sound dispersion for remarkable clarity. Spatial Audio with Dolby Atmos wraps users in immersive sound for music and movies, and studio-quality mics deliver clean, clear audio for calls, recordings, and voice commands. And for the first time, dedicated audio tuning for closed-lid use delivers exceptional sound quality when MacBook Pro is connected to an external display, so users can enjoy a premium audio experience however they work.

The new MacBook Pro packs features for the most demanding users. The PROLED XDR display offers calibration and industry-standard reference modes in a portable form factor, making MacBook Pro an indispensable tool for filmmaking, design, and even medical imaging. 7 And macOS makes the most of the graphics, memory, and machine learning capabilities of Apple silicon, so apps perform at incredible speed.

The new MacBook Pro includes three Thunderbolt 5 ports, HDMI, an SDXC card slot, MagSafe, and a headphone jack. In addition to the PROLED XDR display, it supports up to three external displays with M5 Pro and up to four with M5 Max. Wi-Fi 7 and Bluetooth 6 provide fast, reliable wireless connectivity, and Touch ID enables a quick, easy, and secure login experience. With its fast-charge capability, MacBook Pro can charge up to 50 percent in just 30 minutes. 3 In addition, storage is now configurable up to 16TB.

The new MacBook Pro comes to life with macOS 27. In addition to Touch built for macOS 27, MacBook Pro includes Siri AI, a profoundly more capable, conversational, and personal assistant; helpful Apple Intelligence features across apps; and an expansive set of improvements that make the Mac even more responsive and reliable. Siri AI can draw on personal context to help pros find what they need in the moment across messages, emails, photos, and more; answer questions about virtually any topic; and get things done across apps — all with groundbreaking privacy protections. Siri AI is integrated into Spotlight and systemwide context menus, and users can ask Siri about what’s on their display with Visual Intelligence by using a dedicated keyboard shortcut to get help with a specific item. Pros can also write and edit with Siri almost anywhere they type.

Additionally, Apple Intelligence makes apps smarter and more useful. In Safari, it powers new tools that automatically organize a user’s tabs into topics; notify them of website changes, like product restocks or price drops; and enable the creation of custom extensions based on a description. Pros can also easily create an automation in Shortcuts by simply describing it, or tap into intelligent photo editing tools in the Photos app. Features users already rely on get even better with improvements to performance and search. Refinements to Liquid Glass deliver an even more focused and approachable experience. A new slider in Settings gives users the option to personalize Liquid Glass, adjusting it anywhere from ultraclear to fully tinted to match their preference, and app icons are sharper and more defined.
MacBook Pro with PROLED XDR Display and the Environment

The new MacBook Pro was built with the environment in mind and drives progress toward Apple’s ambitious plan to be carbon neutral across its entire footprint by 2030. It is made with 55 percent recycled content overall, 9 including 100 percent recycled aluminum in the enclosure, 100 percent recycled cobalt in the battery, and, in a first for Apple, 100 percent recycled tantalum in multiple capacitors. It is manufactured with 45 percent renewable electricity, such as wind and solar, across the supply chain. The new MacBook Pro is designed to be durable and repairable, and meets Apple’s high standards for energy efficiency and safe chemistry. As with all Apple products, its paper packaging is 100 percent fiber-based 10 and designed to be recycled.

Apple revolutionized personal technology with the introduction of the Macintosh in 1984. Today, Apple leads the world in innovation with iPhone, iPad, Mac, AirPods, Apple Watch, and Apple Vision Pro. Apple’s six software platforms — iOS, iPadOS, macOS, watchOS, visionOS, and tvOS — provide seamless experiences across all Apple devices and empower people with breakthrough services including the App Store, Apple Music, Apple Pay, iCloud, and Apple TV. Apple’s more than 150,000 employees are dedicated to making the best products on earth and to leaving the world better than we found it.

sources.title: Apple should have made the MacBook logo RGB
passages: Nobody thought Apple would put a touchscreen on a MacBook either, and the iPhone Duo and HomeView also show Apple is in a new age of experimentation during the early Ternus era.
Maybe if the light-up lid logo ever comes to future MacBook Airs or a MacBook Neo, Apple could cut loose a little.

When Apple CEO John Ternus announced the first touchscreen Mac last month, the biggest reaction in the room wasn’t for the PROLED MacBook Pro’s OLED touchscreen or the thinner and lighter chassis; it was for the illuminated lid logo.
The most fun you can have with the Apple lid logo is to install a free third-party app like LogoLight and have it pulse, breathe, match the beat of any music you’re playing, or flash some Morse code.
But that means Apple could have used RGB LEDs.

extraction.body: When Apple CEO John Ternus announced the first touchscreen Mac last month, the biggest reaction in the room wasn’t for the PROLED MacBook Pro’s OLED touchscreen or the thinner and lighter chassis; it was for the illuminated lid logo. It’s a throwback to the light-up logos on the old MacBooks, which Apple started phasing out in 2015, and which were completely gone by the 2018 MacBook Air redesign. Just like in the old days, the new logo’s brightness is linked to the screen’s: The brighter or dimmer the screen, the brighter or dimmer the logo. But the light-up logo on the old MacBooks was illuminated by the screen’s backlight, and an OLED display doesn’t have one. Thanks to iFixit, we now know it’s lit by four white LEDs and synced with the screen’s brightness by software. But that means Apple could have used RGB LEDs. You can turn off the illumination with some Terminal commands or take control of it with a third-party app. But when it’s lit, it’s only lit with white light. And iFixit’s teardown also showed the difficulty of accessing those LEDs (the screen delaminated and broke in the process). The most fun you can have with the Apple lid logo is to install a free third-party app like LogoLight and have it pulse, breathe, match the beat of any music you’re playing, or flash some Morse code. Maybe if the light-up lid logo ever comes to future MacBook Airs or a MacBook Neo, Apple could cut loose a little.

sources.title: What's inside Apple's new glowing logo? iFixit tears down the MacBook Pro OLED - Notebookcheck
passages: Late last month, Apple unveiled its new MacBook Pro models, the first to feature both touchscreens and OLED displays.
Despite adding a touchscreen and bringing back the illuminated logo, Apple has also managed to make the laptop lighter.

The 14-inch model weighs 1.38 kg, around 170 grams less than the comparable M6 MacBook Pro. iFixit's measurements show that Apple reduced the weight of both the aluminum bottom cover and the display assembly while keeping the battery capacity almost unchanged.
The teardown revealed other details about Apple's new laptop.
Its tandem OLED panel has a 120 Hz refresh rate and can reach 2,000 nits of peak brightness.
Under a microscope, iFixit noticed that the blue subpixels are considerably larger than the red and green ones.
Blue OLED materials tend to wear out faster, so giving them a larger area could help reduce the strain on the individual pixels.
The Apple logo itself has a mirror-like coating, so it looks shiny even when the LEDs are switched off.
There is some good news for repairability, too. iFixit found that replacing the display lid is no more difficult than on the previous generation.
The repair process also no longer requires a separate lid-angle sensor, and Apple's repair software successfully recognized a replacement logic board, display and Touch ID sensor.
On older MacBooks, the logo glowed thanks to light from the display's backlight shining through an apple-shaped cutout in the lid.

extraction.body: Late last month, Apple unveiled its new MacBook Pro models, the first to feature both touchscreens and OLED displays. But what many people found even more exciting was the return of the glowing Apple logo on the laptop's lid. iFixit has now published its teardown of the new MacBook Pro, revealing how Apple brought back the iconic feature. On older MacBooks, the logo glowed thanks to light from the display's backlight shining through an apple-shaped cutout in the lid. This meant the logo lit up only when the screen was on. The new MacBook Pro uses a different approach. iFixit found four small LEDs mounted behind the display. Their light passes through a reflective layer and a diffuser, creating an evenly illuminated logo. The Apple logo itself has a mirror-like coating, so it looks shiny even when the LEDs are switched off. Apple removed the illuminated logo in 2016, making its return somewhat ironic: the feature is back only after Apple moved away from the LCD backlight technology that originally made it possible. Getting to the lighting assembly is difficult because it sits behind the display. iFixit damaged the OLED panel and touch-sensitive layers while trying to separate the glass, showing how risky a repair involving the logo or display could be. The repair specialists also found two foam pads behind the display, which they believe provide additional support when users press on the touchscreen. The teardown revealed other details about Apple's new laptop. Its tandem OLED panel has a 120 Hz refresh rate and can reach 2,000 nits of peak brightness. Under a microscope, iFixit noticed that the blue subpixels are considerably larger than the red and green ones. Blue OLED materials tend to wear out faster, so giving them a larger area could help reduce the strain on the individual pixels. Despite adding a touchscreen and bringing back the illuminated logo, Apple has also managed to make the laptop lighter. The 14-inch model weighs 1.38 kg, around 170 grams less than the comparable M6 MacBook Pro. iFixit's measurements show that Apple reduced the weight of both the aluminum bottom cover and the display assembly while keeping the battery capacity almost unchanged. There is some good news for repairability, too. iFixit found that replacing the display lid is no more difficult than on the previous generation. The repair process also no longer requires a separate lid-angle sensor, and Apple's repair software successfully recognized a replacement logic board, display and Touch ID sensor. Both the touchscreen and Touch ID continued to work after the original logic board was reinstalled. However, the laptop still has some familiar repair problems. The fans and USB-C ports are difficult to access because they sit underneath the logic board. The HDMI port and SD card reader are soldered directly to the board, while storage and unified memory remain non-upgradeable. iFixit gave the new 14-inch MacBook Pro with PROLED XDR a repairability score of 5 out of 10, one point higher than the previous M5 model.

iFixit gave the new 14-inch MacBook Pro with PROLED XDR a repairability score of 5 out of 10, one point higher than the previous M5 model.

relevantPassages.text: Late last month, Apple unveiled its new MacBook Pro models, the first to feature both touchscreens and OLED displays.
Despite adding a touchscreen and bringing back the illuminated logo, Apple has also managed to make the laptop lighter.

Its tandem OLED panel has a 120 Hz refresh rate and can reach 2,000 nits of peak brightness.

Blue OLED materials tend to wear out faster, so giving them a larger area could help reduce the strain on the individual pixels.

The repair process also no longer requires a separate lid-angle sensor, and Apple's repair software successfully recognized a replacement logic board, display and Touch ID sensor.
On older MacBooks, the logo glowed thanks to light from the display's backlight shining through an apple-shaped cutout in the lid.

extraction.body: After years of rumors, Apple finally announced its first touchscreen MacBook Pro models on October 28. In addition to being a touchscreen, the new display also uses an OLED panel (dubbed PROLED XDR) for the first time in a MacBook, building on the iPad Pro 's tandem OLED tech. The new machine comes in two sizes — 14-inch and 16-inch — both of which are thinner and lighter than the previous generation. The new MacBook Pro also brings back the glowing Apple logo on the lid, ditches the notch in favor of a pill-shaped camera cutout with a Dynamic Island, and comes with the same M5 Pro and M5 Max chips. The 14-inch model starts at $2,899 and the 16-inch at $3,399, which gives the 14-inch the highest starting price of any MacBook Pro Apple has launched. Both machines arrived at Apple's "Pro and Tell" event in Los Angeles, a day after the company introduced a new 14-inch MacBook Pro and a new iMac , both with the M6 chip. The non-touch M5 Pro and M5 Max MacBook Pro models will remain on sale. The new MacBook Pro uses an OLED panel, which will be a big upgrade for anyone currently using one of these machines, since Apple has used mini-LED panels since 2021. Switching to OLED means the machines can deliver the same per-pixel lighting that gives the iPhone and iPad Pro their deeper blacks and higher contrast. Apple quotes up to 2,000 nits of peak brightness for both HDR and SDR content, a 10,000,000:1 contrast ratio, and a refresh rate that varies from 10Hz to 120Hz. The panel covers P3 and Adobe RGB, and the nano-texture option is etched directly into the cover glass. But the most eye-catching upgrade is that the new MacBook offers touch input across the whole display, on both the 14-inch and 16-inch models. To fully take advantage of the new display, macOS 27 has been revised for fingers rather than just a trackpad. Existing apps will work without any changes, since macOS simply translates a touch into a click. The Dynamic Island also becomes the home for Spotlight, Live Activities, and Siri AI, so searching your Mac or asking Siri a question happens at the top of the screen. The touch sensor sits inside the display panel rather than on top of it, which Apple says reduces latency. Apple spent years telling people it had no interest in putting a touchscreen on a Mac — despite building working prototypes — so this inclusion is a major change for the tech company. Apple's new CEO, John Ternus, reportedly spearheaded the development of the new machine. His position was that Apple had fallen behind on this, and that a touchscreen had become something buyers expect on a laptop rather than a differentiator. Touchscreen Windows laptops have been around for more than a decade, though touch barely registers in the laptop rankings Consumer Reports puts together . The rest of the MacBook Pro also gets somewhat of a redesign. By far the biggest update is the return of the glowing Apple logo on the lid — a fan-favorite feature that was axed back in 2015. Alongside it, the chassis is slightly thinner, the bezels around the display are thinner, and the new machines are noticeably lighter than the models they replace. The 14-inch model drops half a pound to land at 3 pounds, while the 16-inch is 4 pounds. The 16-inch is nearly a millimeter thinner and the 14-inch is half a millimeter thinner, and those slimmer borders grow the screens to 14.2 inches and 16.3 inches. That being said, the overall shape carries over — it still looks like a MacBook Pro. The hinge seems to have received most of Apple's attention, for obvious reasons. Pressing and poking a laptop screen pushes it backward. On most touchscreen laptops, the display rocks every time you tap it. To avoid this, Apple designed its MacBook hinge to hold the display steady even when a finger is prodding at it. This difference will make the MacBook Pro's touchscreen feel solid, which is what you'd expect from such a premium machine. Apple has also added video stabilization that smooths the camera feed if you touch the screen during video calls. Apple reworked the thermal system as well to move air through the hinge, which should improve airflow and cut weight at the same time. Routing heat through the hinge assembly frees up space elsewhere in the chassis, which is part of how these machines got lighter while maintaining the same M5 Pro and M5 Max performance. The ports are the same, with three Thunderbolt 5 connections, HDMI, an SDXC card slot, MagSafe, and a headphone jack. It can support three external displays on M5 Pro and four on M5 Max. Battery life runs up to 24 hours, and the six-speaker system gets a new woofer design that Apple says delivers 50% deeper bass. These machines come with the M5 Pro and M5 Max chips, which are the same options as the MacBook Pro models that Apple released in March. Apple announced a cheaper 14-inch MacBook Pro on October 27, which comes with the newer M6 chip that debuted in the Mac mini in August . The lineup is a little confusing, as Apple's newest chip is in its least expensive MacBook Pro, but the more powerful ones are in the more expensive machines. The M5 Pro and M5 Max processors carry considerably more CPU and GPU cores than the M6 chip and far higher memory bandwidth. That's why the current M5 Max MacBook Pro is as quick as it is during video exports and 3D renders, particularly. If you already own a MacBook Pro with the M5 Pro or M5 Max, upgrading to the new model won't get you any extra performance. The configurations do go further than before, with up to 128GB of unified memory and up to 16TB of storage available. Instead, buyers can now pick between two designs. The M6 14-inch MacBook Pro offers the newest chip, the existing chassis, and a mini-LED display at $1,999. Apple is keeping the non-touch M5 Pro and M5 Max models on sale too, at $2,499 for the 14-inch and $2,999 for the 16-inch if you want the extra power in a familiar chassis. Then, these touchscreen models offer the OLED panel, the lighter body, and the Pro and Max chips at a considerable premium. The 14-inch touchscreen MacBook Pro starts at $2,899 and the 16-inch at $3,399 with M5 Pro, which is $400 more than the non-touchscreen versions of each size. The M5 Max versions cost considerably more, starting at $4,499 for the 14-inch and $4,799 for the 16-inch. Pre-orders open on October 28, with both models arriving on November 6. That makes the 14-inch the most expensive MacBook Pro Apple has ever introduced at launch, surpassing the $2,799 the company charged for the 17-inch model in 2006. Price hikes hit the Mac, iPad, and iPhone lines in June due to the increasing memory and storage costs. Before June, the 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro started at $2,199 and the 16-inch at $2,699, so the touchscreen models represent a jump of at least $700 in four months. For anyone that currently has an Intel MacBook Pro or an M1 model, the new MacBook Pro offers several years of improvements at once. Macs tend to stay useful long enough to make that cost pay off over years. Anyone that already owns an M5 Pro or M5 Max MacBook Pro will be paying $700 or more for a touchscreen, a lighter body, and a better panel, with the same chip inside.

sources.title: Nvidia runs the AI world, now Jensen Huang’s spy scandal could shake it
passages: NEW YORK, Nov 10 — Nvidia chief Jensen Huang sits at the centre of the artificial intelligence boom, and the spy scandal that erupted over the weekend threatens to shake the company at a time when confidence in the AI investment frenzy is already fragile.
“Nvidia without Jensen — I don’t know what that’s worth,” Stephen Witt, author of a book on Huang and Nvidia, told CNBC.
“I simply do not believe he would ever knowingly do anything to disadvantage either America or Nvidia,” said investor Gavin Baker, who has known Huang for almost 30 years.
Bill Bishop, author of the Sinocism newsletter on China, said Huang’s role in deciding who gets Nvidia’s scarce chips made him a valuable target.
Dan Ives of Yorkville Ives & Co called it “a black eye moment” for Huang and said the Nvidia chief was “the core DNA of Nvidia.”
Other investors were less confident Huang would survive the probe launched by the Nvidia board.
Huang has also plowed Nvidia’s windfall into AI startups and labs that spend the money on his chips, a circular arrangement that could spread any trouble at Nvidia across the industry.
“Jensen is not replaceable,” Ives said, adding he expected Huang to remain CEO in the near term but that the board’s findings could still lead to his removal.
“With the new Congress, expect subpoenas and public hearings in which he is trashed and he and Nvidia are further damaged,” Bishop wrote.
That wariness was fuelled by last week’s US elections, in which voters showed anger at AI, tech billionaires and the data centres that house Nvidia’s chips.
The scandal was “a win” for China’s Ministry of State Security, and Huang will now pay the consequences, he concluded. — AFP

extraction.body: NEW YORK, Nov 10 — Nvidia chief Jensen Huang sits at the centre of the artificial intelligence boom, and the spy scandal that erupted over the weekend threatens to shake the company at a time when confidence in the AI investment frenzy is already fragile. Taiwan-born Huang is regarded as the godfather of the AI economy, the executive every player in the industry must turn to because the technology depends on the graphics processing units (GPUs) that his company designs. Those chips have made Nvidia one of the two most valuable companies in the world, alongside Apple. GPUs are in short supply, and the most powerful tech executives and companies rely on Huang to keep them flowing to the data centres that run the models behind OpenAI’s ChatGPT and Anthropic’s Claude. Huang has also plowed Nvidia’s windfall into AI startups and labs that spend the money on his chips, a circular arrangement that could spread any trouble at Nvidia across the industry. “Nvidia without Jensen — I don’t know what that’s worth,” Stephen Witt, author of a book on Huang and Nvidia, told CNBC. “Nvidia is Jensen Huang.” The scandal over Huang’s affair with an alleged Chinese spy lands days before Anthropic’s expected IPO, a Wall Street offering seen as a key test for an industry under pressure as investors show more caution in the AI story. That wariness was fuelled by last week’s US elections, in which voters showed anger at AI, tech billionaires and the data centres that house Nvidia’s chips. Silicon Valley figures rallied to Huang’s defence. Shaun Maguire, a partner at Sequoia Capital, wrote on X that Huang “did something incredibly dumb” that “was bad for America,” but said he believed there had been no bad intention and that Huang was “irreplaceable for America’s AI leadership.” “I simply do not believe he would ever knowingly do anything to disadvantage either America or Nvidia,” said investor Gavin Baker, who has known Huang for almost 30 years. Other investors were less confident Huang would survive the probe launched by the Nvidia board. “I doubt Jensen Huang will be able to remain as Nvidia CEO,” wrote Gary Black of the Future Fund, which counts Nvidia among its largest holdings, adding that Huang had “no natural successor within the company.” “Boards are risk-averse institutions comprised of individuals who worry obsessively about being sued,” he said. Dan Ives of Yorkville Ives & Co called it “a black eye moment” for Huang and said the Nvidia chief was “the core DNA of Nvidia.” “Jensen is not replaceable,” Ives said, adding he expected Huang to remain CEO in the near term but that the board’s findings could still lead to his removal. Huang’s fate will likely be determined in Washington. Ives said the scandal would spark multiple congressional inquiries and increase scrutiny of chip sales to China, a sensitive issue as the AI race between the United States and China accelerates. Huang had persuaded the Trump administration to ease restrictions on chip sales to China and, after donating to some White House causes, became a close adviser to President Donald Trump. But Democrats won control of Congress in last week’s elections, and China hawks from both parties are expected to ask why Trump did not act when he was first told of Huang’s ties to the Chinese businesswoman now suspected of spying for Beijing. Bill Bishop, author of the Sinocism newsletter on China, said Huang’s role in deciding who gets Nvidia’s scarce chips made him a valuable target. “With the new Congress, expect subpoenas and public hearings in which he is trashed and he and Nvidia are further damaged,” Bishop wrote. The scandal was “a win” for China’s Ministry of State Security, and Huang will now pay the consequences, he concluded. — AFP Newswav is an online content aggregator and obtains its content from different online sources. Mr. Huang, the co-founder and chief executive of the Silicon Valley chip giant, stepped down after Nvidia’s board started an inquiry into allegations that he had extramarital affairs with a woman who U.S. intelligence agencies have concluded was spying for China, as well as with an executive who reported to him. It was the stunning fall of one of the most powerful figures in the A.I. boom. Nvidia controls an estimated 90 percent of the market for the advanced chips that are an essential component of artificial intelligence projects. It also touched the White House, where Mr. Huang long had a firm ally in President Trump. The president defended Mr. Huang all week and praised him again on Thursday for doing a “fantastic job”; Mr. Trump then recommended that Tim Cook, the former Apple chief executive, take the helm at Nvidia. A series of reports by The New York Times showed that Mr. Huang, 63, had a relationship with Alice Huang, a Chinese businesswoman who had been recruited by China’s main spy agency to gather information on Mr. Huang. The Times also reported that Mr. Trump had been warned about the relationship but took no action. U.S. officials suspect that Megaspeed, the Singaporean company where Ms. Huang was a top executive, has helped to smuggle restricted chips into China. Ms. Huang has not responded to requests for comment; China has rejected the espionage claims and called the smuggling allegations “smears.” Nvidia’s board : The board did not mention Mr. Huang’s conduct in its statement announcing his resignation. Instead, it thanked him for his “immeasurable contributions to the company and the industry.” Colette Kress, Nvidia’s chief financial officer , will serve as interim chief executive while the search for a permanent replacement is carried out, it said. He is the latest member to join a growing club of chief executives brought down by affairs. sources.title: Nvidia runs the AI world, now Jensen Huang’s spy scandal could shake it
passages: NEW YORK, Nov 10 — Nvidia chief Jensen Huang sits at the centre of the artificial intelligence boom, and the spy scandal that erupted over the weekend threatens to shake the company at a time when confidence in the AI investment frenzy is already fragile.
“Nvidia without Jensen — I don’t know what that’s worth,” Stephen Witt, author of a book on Huang and Nvidia, told CNBC.
“I simply do not believe he would ever knowingly do anything to disadvantage either America or Nvidia,” said investor Gavin Baker, who has known Huang for almost 30 years.
Bill Bishop, author of the Sinocism newsletter on China, said Huang’s role in deciding who gets Nvidia’s scarce chips made him a valuable target.
Dan Ives of Yorkville Ives & Co called it “a black eye moment” for Huang and said the Nvidia chief was “the core DNA of Nvidia.”
Other investors were less confident Huang would survive the probe launched by the Nvidia board.
Huang has also plowed Nvidia’s windfall into AI startups and labs that spend the money on his chips, a circular arrangement that could spread any trouble at Nvidia across the industry.
“Jensen is not replaceable,” Ives said, adding he expected Huang to remain CEO in the near term but that the board’s findings could still lead to his removal.
“With the new Congress, expect subpoenas and public hearings in which he is trashed and he and Nvidia are further damaged,” Bishop wrote.
That wariness was fuelled by last week’s US elections, in which voters showed anger at AI, tech billionaires and the data centres that house Nvidia’s chips.
The scandal was “a win” for China’s Ministry of State Security, and Huang will now pay the consequences, he concluded. — AFP

Taiwan-born Huang is regarded as the godfather of the AI economy, the executive every player in the industry must turn to because the technology depends on the graphics processing units (GPUs) that his company designs. passages: Singapore, a hub for billions of dollars' worth of Nvidia sales each year, finds itself increasingly in the crosshairs of Washington's push to stop advanced AI chips from reaching China, as the chipmaker CEO's scandal once again thrusts the city-state into the spotlight.
Nvidia chips can be legally sold to customers in other countries, such as Malaysia or Singapore, and then illicitly resold or re-exported to China.
The alleged transactions in the broader case totaled about $390 million, prosecutors said March last year.
Singapore has faced growing international scrutiny, particularly from the U.S., over its role as a major billing and potential transit hub for Nvidia chips that U.S. officials say have reached China.

Nvidia's revenue linked to Singapore rose to 22% in the fiscal quarter ending July 2025, up from 8% in 2023, with the country's trade ministry estimating chips physically delivered there accounted for less than 1% of the chipmaker's revenue.

Megaspeed, which was spun off from a Chinese gaming company, became Nvidia's largest Southeast Asian customer in less than three years and has bought more than $4.8 billion worth of its chips since June 2024, according to The New York Times, though the company has denied any wrongdoing.
Nvidia appointed Chief Financial Officer Colette Kress as interim CEO while its board searches for a permanent successor.
